name: Type A Quest Mod Roster

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'mods/**'
      - 'index.toml'
      - 'pack.toml'
      - 'manifest/mods.json'
      - 'manifest/quest_chapters.json'
      - 'manifest/quest_mod_roster_current.json'
      - 'scripts/audit_quest_mod_roster.py'
      - 'tests/test_quest_mod_roster_a.py'
      - '.github/workflows/quest-mod-roster-a.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  quest-mod-roster-a:
    name: A-QMOD source roster & coverage inventory
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Type A (source-only) full indexed roster audit
        run: python scripts/audit_quest_mod_roster.py --check
      - name: Test Type A roster fixtures
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_quest_mod_roster_a.py' -v
